summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtins feature (uncommitted). Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins str-enum (11 members, commented) at module end and an enum import; botocore/args.py adds the EPRBuiltins import, makes _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults after _ensure_boolean; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (one test per behavioral criterion, including the mocked S3 predicate called-once test and one custom-data and one bundled-data SDK endpoint test). Verification: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (58 tests); test_regions.py, test_client.py and test_args.py together pass (414 tests). black, isort and flake8 are not installed in the shared venv, so they were not run; line lengths were checked with awk. Only over-79 line in touched files is botocore/args.py:315, which predates this change. Caveat: the FIPS and DualStack lookups call the bridge's private methods _resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint, since no public equivalents exist.
